batch_atomic_data_list: batch a list of AtomicData objects into a single batch using atomicdata_list_to_batch
compute_neighbors_from_edge_index: compute neighbor counts from edge_index for each AtomicData in the list and attach to batch
collate_to_dict: collate a list of AtomicData objects and return the batch as a dictionary of tensors
collate_with_otf_graph: collate a list of AtomicData objects with otf_graph enabled to skip neighbor computation
review_data_list_collater: review the data_list_collater function to understand how AtomicData objects are batched and converted
